title: CRISPR-Cas9 off-target prediction and budgeted evidence triage
authority_ceiling: Literature-derived research contract only; no biological, clinical, safety, or experimental authority

sources.note: The companion code reproduces analysis from standardized tool outputs; it does not rerun every tool in its native environment. Code license is not automatically a data license.

sources.data_use_restriction: Non-commercial research only; commercial predictive-model training/development, gene-editing tool design, and commercial software integration are prohibited without prior written permission
sources.allowed_current_use: Literature context only; do not ingest restricted study data or use it for model development without written permission
sources.note: Published metrics are context-specific and must not be generalized across editors, cells, assays, or modalities.

metric_planes.definition: Whether a native genome-wide search method nominates measured positive sites before any positive seeding
Ranking performance conditional on one exact, declared candidate universe; report whether validated positives were seeded
Analytical sensitivity/precision of an experimental nomination/confirmation method under its exact assay and study conditions
Candidate-site review burden required to achieve preregistered ranking/recall criteria
Worst/best-case assignment of unknown/unassayed candidate labels within one exact, declared candidate universe; not a confidence interval and not a bound on candidates omitted from that universe

symbols.U: unknown/unassayed candidates in the fixed candidate universe

limitations: requires P > 0 for recall bounds and K > 0 with at least K candidates for precision bounds
bounds apply only to unknown labels inside the fixed candidate universe
cannot bound true positives omitted by every candidate nomination method
not a probability, confidence interval, posterior estimate or safety guarantee

primary_impact_alternatives.target: At least +5 absolute percentage points in macro Recall@K vs best fair baseline on preregistered held-out guide/Cas9 groups
primary_impact_alternatives.caveat: Must report precision and false negatives; requires a group-aware uncertainty interval.

primary_impact_alternatives.target: At least 20% fewer candidate review slots to achieve the baseline's preregistered recall target
primary_impact_alternatives.caveat: Candidate slots are a review-burden proxy, not measured laboratory cost or treatment-price reduction.

aspirational_engineering_targets.inferential_rule: Describe improvement as demonstrated only if the preregistered interval excludes no improvement; otherwise report inconclusive/null.
aspirational_engineering_targets.external_generalization: Require at least one independent, use-permitted cohort before claiming robustness across datasets.
aspirational_engineering_targets.safety_rule: No model score, rank improvement, or cryptographic receipt implies a guide, editor, or therapy is safe.

preconditions: identical candidate ID universe for both policies
same latent outcome assignment for each unknown candidate across policies
same eligible measured-positive reference and K

symbols.d: known-positive hits in A top K minus B top K
symbols.a: unknown IDs selected by A but not B
symbols.b: unknown IDs selected by B but not A
symbols.n: all remaining unknown IDs selected by both or neither

lower_bound.denominator: P + b + (n when d - b > 0, else 0)

upper_bound.denominator: P + a + (n when d + a < 0, else 0)

paired_label_sensitivity.claim_rule: A positive paired worst-case lower bound supports label-robust superiority only within the fixed candidate universe. If bounds span zero, describe any supported statistical gain as observed-label improvement, not label-robust improvement.
limitations: not a statistical confidence interval or posterior
cannot account for true sites omitted from every nomination method
does not establish biological safety or clinical utility
